lines.text: Come again? It's too loud here.

data.define: A casual way to ask someone to repeat.

example.text: Come again? It's too loud here.

misuse.text: Don't say 'come again' when you heard clearly.

data.l1_hook: माफ़ करना, संगीत बहुत तेज़ है! क्या आप "come again" कह सकते हैं?
data.l1_ex: Come again? यहाँ बहुत तेज़ है।
